jessica-support: FYI customer ACME (acct: acct_0xACME) hit a negative promo balance after a chargeback. Case CS-18923. They had a $100 promo code applied, then a chargeback rolled through and the credit-clawback logic seems to have double-applied. Repro steps in next message.

laura-cs: Can you paste the exact timeline + transaction IDs? I want to respond to the customer with what's happening.

jessica-support: Timeline: 1) 2026-12-04T15:02:01Z promo grant promo_100 -> credit +100 2) 2026-12-05T11:10:42Z chargeback tx cb_811 processed -> system clawback removed promo (expected) 3) 2026-12-05T11:10:55Z billing-sync job retried and re-applied promo delta +100 (unexpected) 4) 2026-12-05T11:12:03Z refund reversal processed -> net effect customer shows -100 balance. TX IDs: promo_100, cb_811, sync_job_221.

marc_support: Account ID and the customer-visible balance snapshot? Also any API error they reported?

jessica-support: acct_0xACME, UI shows "Balance: -$100 (promo)". They reported API 429 earlier but that's separate; main blocker is balance negative and invoices failing.

eng-oncall: I pulled the sync job logs and can reproduce in staging. Root cause looks like a race between chargeback handler (path A) and the async credits-sync worker (path B). Path A marks promo as clawed and writes status=clawed. Path B reads before the DB transaction commits and writes back the old promo delta, effectively re-applying it.

eng-oncall: Relevant log snippet: ```
INFO 2026-12-05T11:10:42Z chargeback.handler cb_811 remove_promo delta=-100 -> status=clawed
DEBUG 2026-12-05T11:10:55Z credits-sync job sync_job_221 read_promo status=active delta=+100
WARN 2026-12-05T11:10:55Z credits-sync job sync_job_221 wrote delta=+100 (race)```

phil-billing: Sounds like missing DB transaction isolation on the sync worker. Short mitigation: pause credits-sync for the affected shard and manually reconcile ACME. I can run a manual adjustment. Command we use: `POST /admin/accounts/acct_0xACME/credits/adjust` body `{ "delta": 100, "reason": "manual reconciliation: chargeback clawback fix CS-18923" }`

marta: I'll coordinate manual fix and notify customer once done. Phil, can you provide the exact audit log entry we should include?

phil-billing: After I run adjust I'll paste the audit id. Also filing an internal bug: BUG-745 (credits-sync race on chargeback path). Assigning to eng-runtime.

srebot: [alert] billing-sync-worker shard-12 FAILED 2026-12-05T11:10:55Z status=500 retry=3

eng-oncall: Proposed longer-term fixes: 1) Credits-sync should use read-after-write consistency (SELECT ... FOR UPDATE) or check version token before write. 2) Chargeback handler should emit an event that invalidates sync cache. 3) Add an idempotency key to credits writes. I'll open PR for a quick patch after I finish the hotfix.

laura-cs: Good. From CS side: customer needs a clear timeline + confirmation of manual adjustment. Also please confirm whether their trial/promo is recovered or permanently removed.

jessica-support: I'll draft the customer reply once we have the audit id and the reconciliation timestamp.

phil-billing: Manual adjustment completed at 2026-12-05T12:03:05Z audit_id=aud_5509. Balance now returns to $0. I left a note: "manual reconciliation for chargeback race - CS-18923"

marta: Noted. I've updated the case and messaged the customer. They want assurance this won't reoccur.

eng-oncall: I pushed hotfix (credits-sync uses FOR UPDATE) to staging and will push to prod in 30m if no regressions. PR: https://git.internal/r/redwood/credits/1234.

laura-cs: Thanks everyone. I'll close the customer loop after the prod deploy. :thumbsup:

jessica-support: Closing action items: phil/manual adjust done, BUG-745 filed, eng hotfix queued. Followups: postmortem + test for chargeback->credits race.

marta: I'll add the postmortem note to incidents.
